verdict.rationale: Gitea ships its own CI/CD system, Gitea Actions. It is GitHub Actions-compatible, with workflows written in YAML and the ability to reuse existing Actions plugins from any Git site, so pipelines can be defined as code in the repository. Automatic triggering is implied by that compatibility but not stated explicitly. Kubernetes autoscaling runners are also listed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of push and pull-request triggers, details on runner setup and execution, and independent or hands-on confirmation that Gitea Actions works (community reports cover the external Drone integration instead).
